queries:
SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT city_id) FROM address) AS ratio_to_avg, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM address) AS share
FROM address
GROUP BY city_id
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT c.city
FROM city c
JOIN address a ON a.city_id = c.city_id
GROUP BY c.city_id, c.city
HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM address) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM city);

SELECT c.city, COUNT(a.address_id) AS address_count
FROM city c
LEFT JOIN address a ON a.city_id = c.city_id
GROUP BY c.city_id, c.city
ORDER BY address_count DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT city_id,
       COUNT(*) AS address_count,
       COUNT(*) * 1.0 / ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM address) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT city_id) FROM address)) AS ratio_to_average,
       COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM address) AS share
FROM address
GROUP BY city_id;

SELECT city_id,
       COUNT(*) AS address_count,
       COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT city_id) FROM address) AS ratio_to_average,
       COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM address) AS share
FROM address
GROUP BY city_id
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10;
